u0: The agent has not yet toggled the switch and has not entered the exit. The required order still lies ahead: toggle the switch at least once before reaching the exit. Reaching the exit now would violate the requirement and fail the task.
u1: The switch has been toggled at least once, so the required ordering restriction is satisfied. The agent may now proceed to the exit without violating that requirement. This is not itself a completion state; the episode continues until the agent reaches the exit or the step limit.
u2: The agent entered the exit before ever toggling the switch, violating the mandatory order. Successful completion is no longer possible, so this is the failure state.
